title: 第1章 我真没偷看她们洗澡第2章 我叫鹿瑶瑶见过周师兄
slug: 掌门师伯新收了个女徒弟
content_zh:
“所以，你为什么要偷看她们洗澡？”
“我不道啊，我刚睡醒……”
“小灵峰周清，这里可是戒律堂，我希望你能如实交代。”
“我是真不知道啊，昨晚喝多后我就在那块石头上睡着了，一睁眼就看到她们在脱衣服。”
“你的意思是说，她们整整十八个女孩，都没看到你？”
“应该是。”
“就那么巴掌大的一块温泉，你就躺在池边，她们十八双眼睛都把你忽略了？”
“说的是呢，我倒觉得，是她们压根没把我当人看，确切地说，当男人看。”
“呵呵，你觉得我们信吗？”
“咱先别说信不信，换作你偷看，会明目张胆地趴在池边看吗？”
“这个，的确有点说不通，或许是你胆大呢？想看仔细呢？”
“你们这就有点看不起我了，好歹我周清是小灵峰的核心弟子，眼神这方面不用怀疑，再者说，明明是我先喊的，怎么就把我抓了呢？”
“那为什么等她们脱成那种程度才喊？”
“我都说了，我当时在睡觉。”
…………
戒律堂外，十几个女子哭哭啼啼地不成样子，一些身着黑衣的戒律堂人员一边安慰，一边进行问话。
“那处温泉平日里很少人去的，你们怎么就突然想起来结伴去那里呢？”
“就没有一人察觉到被跟踪吗？”
“是你们谁先发现的？”
…………

咻！
刀气横空，很快就化为一名圆脸小眼，身材却较为壮实的男子。
男子一脸焦急，落下后匆忙扫了一眼这些女子，直接冷哼一声。
“就你们这种货色，也配我小师弟偷看？”
说完后，也不再理会这些噤若寒蝉的女弟子们，便直接闯入戒律堂。
不久后，他顶着一对黑眼圈，流着鼻血，得意洋洋地带着周清从里面出来。
周清看着他的样子，不由叹了一口气。
“三师兄，你说你这顿打挨的冤不冤？明明我都快自证完了，你非要喊着是哪个王八羔子抓的人，堂主他们又怎能不生气。”周清道。
闫小虎一时有些尴尬，轻轻一碰鼻子，顿时疼得呲牙咧嘴。
本就一对小眼，很快就肿得只剩下一条缝了。
闫小虎道：“我这不是一时着急给忘了吗。”
太清门十三峰，弟子分为外门、内门、真传和核心四个阶层。
唯有核心弟子是直接拜入各峰峰主名下的，他们若犯错，可是由戒律堂三位堂主联合审判的。
“所以，你真没看她们洗澡？”闫小虎勉强睁着眼睛，扫了一圈四周，刚才那些女的这会儿也不知道去了哪里。
周清道：“我真没有，要是偷看不可能不叫你，况且，昨晚咱俩不是在那里喝酒吗，那温泉还是你喝大后徒手刨出来的，你忘了？”
闫小虎愣愣地看着指甲缝里的黑渍。
“我说大中午起来手指咋这么痛呢，你这么一说似乎有点印象了，不是，我记得你明明走了啊，怎么还在那里睡着呢？”
闫小虎疑惑问道。
周清气愤道：“我酒量差你不是不知道，把我喝成那样，你却拍拍屁股就走了，要不然哪会有现在这事。”
content_en:
"So, why did you peek at them taking a bath?"
"I don't know, I just woke up..."
"Xiaoling Peak Zhou Qing, this is the Discipline Hall. I hope you can tell the truth."
"I really don't know. After drinking too much last night, I fell asleep on that rock. When I opened my eyes, I saw them taking off their clothes."
"You mean, all eighteen of them girls didn't even see you?"
"Probably."
"It's just such a palm-sized hot spring, and you're lying by the pool, and all their eighteen pairs of eyes ignore you?"
"That's right. I think they don't see me as a human being at all. To be precise, they see me as a man."
"Haha, do you think we believe it?"
"Let's not say whether we believe it or not. If you were peeping, would you lie down by the pool blatantly and watch?"
"This does not make sense. Maybe you are brave? Do you want to take a closer look?"
"You guys are looking down on me. After all, I, Zhou Qing, am the core disciple of Xiaoling Peak. There is no need to doubt my eyes. Besides, it was obviously me who shouted first, so why did you arrest me?"
"Then why did you wait until they had stripped down to that level before shouting?"
"I told you, I was sleeping at the time."
…………
Outside the Discipline Hall, more than a dozen women were crying and crying. Some members of the Discipline Hall in black were comforting and questioning them.
"Very few people go to that hot spring on weekdays. Why do you suddenly think of going there together?"
"Didn't anyone realize they were being followed?"
"Which of you discovered it first?"
…………
Phew!
The sword energy flew through the air, and he soon transformed into a man with a round face, small eyes, and a relatively strong build.
The man looked anxious, glanced at the women hastily, and snorted coldly.
"A guy like you is worthy of my little junior brother peeking at you?"
After finishing speaking, he ignored these silent female disciples and walked directly into the Discipline Hall.
Not long after, he came out with a pair of dark circles under his eyes and a nosebleed, triumphantly leading Zhou Qing.
Zhou Qing looked at him and couldn't help but sigh.
"Third Senior Brother, do you think you were unjustly beaten? I'm almost done proving myself, but if you insist on calling out which bastard arrested the person, how can the hall master and the others not be angry?" Zhou Qing said.
Yan Xiaohu was a little embarrassed for a moment. He touched his nose lightly and grinned in pain.
The eyes were originally small, but soon became swollen until only a slit remained.
Yan Xiaohu said: "Didn't I forget it in my hurry?"
In the Thirteen Peaks of Taiqing Sect, disciples are divided into four levels: outer sect, inner sect, true disciple and core.
Only the core disciples are directly under the name of the masters of each peak. If they make mistakes, they will be judged jointly by the three masters of the Discipline Hall.
"So, you really didn't see them taking a bath?" Yan Xiaohu barely opened his eyes and scanned the surroundings. He didn't know where those women had gone now.
Zhou Qing said: "I really didn't. I couldn't help but call you if I peeked. Besides, weren't we drinking there last night? The hot spring was dug out with your bare hands after you drank too much. Have you forgotten?"
Yan Xiaohu stared blankly at the black stains between his nails.
"I said my fingers hurt so much when I woke up in the middle of the day. You seemed to have an impression when you said that. No, I remember you were gone. Why are you still sleeping there?"
Yan Xiaohu asked doubtfully.
Zhou Qing said angrily: "You don't know that I have a bad drinking ability. You drank me like that, but you slapped me on the butt and left. Otherwise, how would this happen?"
